summary_markdown:
A review of firmware performance was conducted. The behavior of `DP_MC2` remains concerning, showing lower traffic compared to other units even after a firmware update (from 53.5 to 53), suggesting the issue is not related to the firmware itself. A second concern involves `DP_MC8`, where real-time data does not drop to zero. It was noted that this behavior might be acceptable due to placement, but re-testing is recommended because similar issues were observed previously in Finland and Germany.

Separately, a discussion occurred regarding selecting a batch of sensors for an update. A suggestion was made to try Kronen, with caution advised when working with someone else.
decisions: Re-test the behavior of `DP_MC8` despite potential placement justification.
action_items: Test sensors on one unit first, then proceed to others.
